grammar: 本課練習用 Where is…? 以及介系詞 in、on、under、near、behind 描述位置。
intro_zh: 這一課我們將學習描述房子的不同部份和位置，練習用 Where is…? 問句和介系詞 in、on、under、near、behind 說明東西放在哪裡。
can_do: 能用 Where is…? 問詢物品的位置。
能正確使用 in、on、under、near、behind 描述位置。
能閱讀簡短的家庭情境故事並說出關鍵詞彙。

sentences.en: We move into a new house that my dad helped build.
sentences.zh: 我們搬進爸爸幫忙建造的新房子。

sentences.en: Some of my friends live in an apartment near our house.
sentences.zh: 我有些朋友住在我們家附近的公寓。

sentences.en: The house has two floors and a small garden on the ground.
sentences.zh: 這棟房子有兩層樓，地面上有一個小花園。

sentences.en: On the first floor, there is a living room with a big window, and the lamp is on the table in the living room.
sentences.zh: 一樓有一個客廳，裡面有大窗戶，燈放在客廳的桌子上。

sentences.en: Next to the living room is the dining room where we eat meals.
sentences.zh: 客廳旁邊是飯廳，我們在那裡吃飯。

sentences.en: The kitchen is behind the dining room, and Mom often fixes breakfast there.
sentences.zh: 廚房在飯廳後面，媽媽常在那裡準備早餐。

sentences.en: Upstairs, there are three bedrooms and a bathroom; my bedroom is near the stairs, and I keep my toys under the bed.
sentences.zh: 樓上有三間臥室和一間浴室；我的臥室靠近樓梯，我把玩具放在床下。

sentences.en: The bathroom has a restroom, a sink, and a mirror on the wall.
sentences.zh: 浴室裡有馬桶、洗手盤和牆上的鏡子。

sentences.en: When I come home, I knock on the door and say, 'I'm home!'
sentences.zh: 我回家時會敲門並說：『我回來了！』

grammar_points.title_zh: ① 用 Where is...? 詢問「……在哪裡？」與回答
grammar_points.explain_zh: 想詢問某個人或單數物品在何處時，句子開頭用「Where is + 對象?」（Where is 常縮寫為 Where's）。回答時，人稱代名詞可用 He / She / It，搭配「be 動詞 + 地方介系詞片語」。

grammar_points.title_zh: ② 常見的位置介系詞：in, on, under, near, behind
grammar_points.explain_zh: 介系詞用來說明人或物品與周圍環境的相對位置。常見的五個單字為：in（在……裡面）、on（在……上面）、under（在……下面）、near（在……附近/旁邊）、behind（在……後面）。

examples.en: The dog is sleeping under the window.
examples.zh: 狗狗正在窗戶下面睡覺。

examples.en: The picture on the wall is very pretty.
examples.zh: 牆壁上的那幅畫非常漂亮。

examples.en: My brother is behind the door.

lines.en: Dad, where is Mom? Is she in the living room?
lines.zh: 爸爸，媽媽在哪裡？她在客廳裡嗎？

lines.en: No, she is in the garden. She wants to build a small bird house.
lines.zh: 不在，她在花園裡。她想要建造一間小鳥屋。

lines.en: Can I go help her? Where are my boots?
lines.zh: 我可以去幫她嗎？我的靴子在哪裡？

lines.en: They are near the door. Please knock on the door before you go out.
lines.zh: 靴子在門旁邊。你出去之前請先敲門。

lines.en: Okay! Look, our cat is under the lamp!
lines.zh: 好的！你看，我們的貓咪在檯燈下面耶！

sentences.en: My grandparents live in a clean apartment on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母住在二樓一間乾淨的公寓裡。

sentences.en: Dad can fix the broken window in the dining room.
sentences.zh: 爸爸會修理飯廳那扇壞掉的窗戶。

sentences.en: Is the restroom near the bathroom?
The yellow lamp is behind the sofa near the wall.
sentences.zh: 黃色的檯燈在靠近牆壁的沙發後面。

sentences.en: The dry leaves are on the ground in our garden.
sentences.zh: 枯葉落在我們花園的地面上。

sentences.en: My bedroom is the quietest room in the house.
sentences.zh: 我的臥房是這棟房子裡最安靜的房間。

sentences.en: Please knock on the door before you enter my room.
sentences.zh: 進我的房間前請先敲門。

sentences.en: Mom is at home, cooking dinner in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 媽媽在家，正在廚房裡做晚餐。

fill.q: Where is the lamp? It is ____ the floor.（在地板上）
Where is the door? It is ____ the wall.（在牆上）
Where is the window? It is ____ the door.（在門旁邊）
Where is the lamp? It is ____ the window.（在窗戶下面）
Where is the lamp? It is ____ the door.（在門後面）
Where is the kitchen? It is ____ the house.（在房子裡）
Where is the bedroom? It is ____ the apartment.（在公寓裡）
Where is the garden? It is ____ the house.（在房子附近）
Where is the bathroom? It is ____ the floor.（在樓層上）
Where is the restroom? It is ____ the ground.（在地下）

translate.ans: The living room is in the house.
The kitchen is in the house.
The bathroom is on the floor.
The garden is near the house.
The door is on the wall.
The window is on the wall.
The lamp is on the floor.
The lamp is under the window.

unscramble.q: the / The / is / on / . / lamp / floor
unscramble.ans: The lamp is on the floor.

unscramble.q: the / wall / is / . / The / on / door
unscramble.ans: The door is on the wall.

unscramble.q: the / The / is / . / near / door / window
unscramble.ans: The window is near the door.

unscramble.q: is / near / The / the / . / garden / house
unscramble.ans: The garden is near the house.

unscramble.q: floor / The / the / bathroom / is / on / .
unscramble.ans: The bathroom is on the floor.

unscramble.q: lamp / under / the / . / is / window / The
unscramble.ans: The lamp is under the window.
